title: Ninja Swirl by Creami NC701 $329 + Delivery ($0 to Select Areas) @ Woolworths Group via Everyday Market
body:
Deal: Ninja Swirl by Creami NC701 $329 + Delivery ($0 to Select Areas) @ Woolworths Group via Everyday Market

[Uncle Roger] It says "About Everyday Market" on the listing, so should be fine!
[Fredfloresjr] Great machine if you are drinking whey protein every day. Enjoying mine a lot. Substituting full meal to One pint of this is game changer especially when your are tracking macros.
I have 4 extra Pints from amazon (generic), prepping every Sunday for less than an 30 mins. Happy days
[ATangk] So whats a full meal, 400ml milk + 2 scoops of protein? Give us a recipe!
[dajackal] Should I wait until the non swirl model goes under $200 as I have no interest in softserve?
I'm also waiting. I wouldn't mind softserve, but probably too much cleaning up.
[Headless] It's actually very well designed in terms of cleaning, I bung everything in the dishwasher
[cheekymonkey97] $39 postage to WA is just insane. Kills the deal.
[UncleRico] Outstanding. Thanks OP!
And on an utterly unrelated note, does anyone else think KFC may be overestimating the appeal of the pickle, lately?
[base2aau] I got this one, the swirl function is a bit of a gimmick and increases the footprint but I have been making ice cream every single day, I never knew I could enjoy ice cream in so many ways. I still can't believe that skim milk a scoop of protein powder and 1/4 teaspoon of xanthan gum can make amazing ice cream.
Highly recommend this protein powder 1/2 price at chemist warehouse at the moment
Musashi High Protein Vanilla 900g
https://www.chemistwarehouse.com.au/buy/62726/musashi-high-p…
[Mick83] $38.95 Delivery to Metro Perth area kills it
[WhatsOnDiscount] Bought one of these a few months ago when they were on special from bing lee: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/964029
Great with kids as you know what you are putting into the ice cream and sugar etc. they’ll also enjoy doing the soft serve thing
The machine is for home use, not ideal for larger groups or parties as much.
